title: Count Dooku
subtitle: Face of the Confederacy
text: Action [Exhaust]: Play a Separatist card from your hand. It gains Exploit 1. (You may defeat 1 unit you control. If you do, that card costs 2 resources less.)
deployBox:
Overwhelm (When attacking an enemy unit, deal excess damage to the opponent’s base.)
On Attack: The next Separatist card you play this phase gains Exploit 3.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 7 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
The Exploit 3 from Dooku's “On Attack” ability remains active even if he is defeated.
Abilities that let you play a card require you to pay that card's cost unless specified otherwise.
(ERRATA) Action [Exhaust]: Play a Separatist card from your hand. It gains Exploit 1 for this phase.
